DEFINITION · qeva:1:group@1

Group

A group captures reversible composition with an identity.

editorialalgebra · symmetry
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

A group captures reversible composition with an identity.

EXACT

The compact statement

A group (G,·) has associativity, an identity e, and for every g an inverse g⁻¹; closure is part of ·:G×G→G.

Example

Integers under addition form a group.

Boundary / caveat

Commutativity is an extra condition, not part of the group definition.

Assumptions

  • The declared abstract algebra context is fixed.
